Жакып, Акбалтайдын Ала-Тоону карай көчө баштаганы. Жолойдун
аларга катуу чабуул койгону
headings.en: Jakyp and Akbaltay begin migrating toward Ala-Too. Zholoy launches a fierce attack upon them.

headings.en: Akbaltay and Jakyp confer about submitting to Zholoy by presenting girls and livestock as tribute. Manas refuses, fights and wins.
